value.answer: Depends which football you mean. Soccer: Messi. It's still debated, with Ronaldo the main argument against, but the most recent sources have Messi on top. He has a record eight Ballon d'Ors, won the 2022 World Cup, and is the World Cup's all-time leading scorer with 18 goals. NFL: Tom Brady, with seven championships, though he himself says Jerry Rice is the greatest.
